itemListElement.name: Granola vs Otter AI in 2026: Which Suits US Teams?

mainEntity.name: Is Granola better than Otter AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on what you need. For private, bot-free notes with no minute caps, Granola is better. For live transcripts, automatic recording and CRM integrations, Otter wins. The real question is whether you want notes or a full record, so test both on the same 3 meetings.

Yes. Otter remains a strong transcription tool with live captions, speaker identification and integrations. Its main drawbacks are the 30-minute cap on free conversations and the visible bot. Upgrading to Pro raises the per-conversation limit to 90 minutes and adds Salesforce, HubSpot and Zapier integrations for $8.33 a month on annual billing.

Not quite. Granola transcribes your meeting audio to write notes, but it does not show a live transcript on screen the way Otter does. What you get is structured notes rather than a word-for-word transcript view, so if you need to quote exact words later, Otter's transcript view suits you better.

mainEntity.name: How much does Otter AI cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pro costs $16.99 a month on monthly billing or $8.33 a month billed yearly. Business costs $30 a month or $19.99 billed yearly. The Basic plan is free with 300 minutes a month. Annual billing roughly halves Otter Pro's monthly price.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Granola and Otter together?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can, but it is rarely worth paying for both. Running 2 note takers doubles the notes to review and may confuse attendees. Pick the one that matches how you work. If you need both a live transcript and private notes, Lynkk offers a bot for Zoom, Meet and Teams plus bot-free recording in one account.

mainEntity.name: Which is better for Microsoft Teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Otter's agent joins Microsoft Teams meetings directly. Granola captures Teams calls through its Mac or Windows desktop app instead. Both work, though only Otter needs nothing open on your machine.
